evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

Lieberman, MD, PC"Before Tandem, I could maybe do 10 PAs a day, but that's not including all the legwork. Realistically, it felt like 5 fully worked-up PAs. evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://withtandem.com/blog/how-docs-dermatology-accelerated-medication-access-across-140-locations
evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.title: https://withtandem.com/blog/how-docs-dermatology-accelerated-medication-access-across-140-locations
evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://withtandem.com/blog/how-docs-dermatology-accelerated-medication-access-across-140-locations
evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://withtandem.com/blog/how-docs-dermatology-accelerated-medication-access-across-140-locations
evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior Authorizations | OpenEvidenceOpenEvidence has signed content agreements with NEJM, JAMA, NCCN, Wiley, Cochrane, and more.Log InSign UpNew VisitOpenEvidence and Tandem Partner to Streamline Evidence-Based Prescribing and Prior AuthorizationsApril 2, 2026OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patientMIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications.This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment.OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients.Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access.“Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.”“As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.”By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered.—About TandemTandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treat

evidence.title: https://withtandem.com/blog/how-docs-dermatology-accelerated-medication-access-across-140-locations
evidence.text: How DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locations - Tandem | AI for Prior Authorizations & Medication Access Support DoctorsPatientsBlogCareersLog inCreate accountHow DOCS Dermatology Group accelerated medication access across 140 locationsDec 1, 2025When DOCS Dermatology Group, a leading dermatology network spanning ten states, began exploring ways to improve patient access and reduce administrative burden, one challenge stood out: the time and effort required to complete prior authorizations (PAs).Like many specialty practices, DOCS providers wanted to help patients start therapy faster. But with hundreds of biologic and non-biologic prescriptions being written each week, manual paperwork, faxes, and follow-up calls had become major bottlenecks.To streamline the process, DOCS partnered with Tandem, an AI-powered platform that automates PAs, appeals, enrollment forms, and pharmacy routing – and integrates directly with the EHR.LocationMidwest, South, and Mid-AtlanticSize300+ cliniciansSpecialtyDermatologyThe Challenge: Manual Workflows Slowed Patient AccessBefore Tandem, each provider’s team was spending hours a week submitting and tracking PAs across multiple payers and pharmacies. The manual nature of the process caused:Delays in treatment for patients waiting on approvalsInconsistent communication between providers, payers, and pharmaciesLimited visibility into where each request stood in the workflowWith 300+ clinicians across 140+ locations in the Midwest, South and Mid-Atlantic regions, DOCS needed a scalable, automated solution that could bring consistency to PA management without adding new administrative headcount.The Solution: Automating Prior Authorizations with TandemDOCS Dermatology Group began its Tandem rollout with a single pilot provider. Within weeks, the results were clear.Tandem’s automation enabled same-day prior authorization submissions, intelligent tracking, and automatic population of payer-specific forms, eliminating manual re-entry and phone tag.Following the success of the pilot, DOCS expanded Tandem across 10 states – Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia, Illinois, Texas, Louisiana, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Indiana, and North Carolina – and now supports more than 300 providers on the platform.The ResultsAfter implementing Tandem, DOCS Dermatology Group saw significant improvements in both patient outcomes and staff efficiency:Same-day prior authorization submission<1 day average time to receive approval80% increase in patients accessing their medicationsProviders across the network report faster approvals, fewer delays between prescription and fulfillment, and dramatically reduced administrative burden for medical assistants and coordinators.Voices from DOCS Clinics“Tandem has allowed me to have more oversight over the PA process, while simultaneously cutting down on my time/hours worked. It has improved delay in care between Rx being written and delivery to patient.”— Physician Assistant“Th
